meta.title: ASI V2 Architecture — Failure Points (Tasks 01/12/13/22)
meta.description: Component map of the 12 pictured component IDs from docs/architecture-baseline.json with failure annotations for Task 01 (8 arch + 20 dep violations), Task 12 (sandbox unqualified), Task 13 (journal/dispatch unfinished), Task 22 (MCP blocked by 13/19). Database: PostgreSQL 17 running locally (admin123). All checks preserved; no weakening.

boundaries.label: ARCH-001: channels must not import provider SDK directly
STORE_DRIVER_BYPASS: tools must use memStore, not pg directly
Allowed: privRouter -> memStore via qualified wrapper
QUEUE_PACKAGE: bullmq allowed for specialists + control outbox

failureAnnotations.label: Task 01 BLOCKED
failureAnnotations.detail: 8 arch violations (cross-boundary DB/stores/queues), 20 unpinned dependencies, 169 type errors, 792 lint errors. Checker enforced; checks not weakened. Evidence in docs/task-ledger.json (blocked qualification).

failureAnnotations.label: Task 12 BLOCKED
failureAnnotations.detail: Sandbox qualification unproven. Docker running but image/rootfs digests still contain placeholders. Tests at tests/security/sandbox.test.ts:42 allow false = pass; needs real Linux filesystem/network/credential/resource/cancellation/cleanup proof.

failureAnnotations.label: Task 13 BLOCKED
failureAnnotations.detail: 4 failing tests; journal overwrite fixed (writer_epoch + no ON CONFLICT) but governed dispatch unfinished. Needs real PostgreSQL reconciliation + budget/integration proof.

failureAnnotations.label: Task 22 BLOCKED
failureAnnotations.detail: MCP fixtures pass (53 loopback). SDK @modelcontextprotocol/client 2.3.1 installed (ADR0002). Blocked by Task 13 + Task 19 integration: identity -> policy -> budget -> isolation -> receipt -> recovery.

failureAnnotations.label: PostgreSQL 17 CONNECTED
failureAnnotations.detail: Local DB running (admin123); DATABASE_URL set; 113 qualification tests passed (identity + control). Used for budget/policy/memory/episodic integration.
